headline: One picture, 360 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 360 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 360 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 1 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.007 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): f52855b90a56 on 346 works, 377cef8d315e on 14 works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (360).
